_about: Expected results computed by the notebook (scipy linprog, HiGHS). A JavaScript port must reproduce kpi values within tolerance: Mt ±0.05, NPV ±0.5%, Invested ±1 US$m. Per-project allocations may differ only where two projects are exactly tied.

recommendations: Commit US$ 10.0 bn across 10 countries and 4 project types, led by China (US$ 2.3 bn).
The single biggest lever is 'Rice paddy water management (AWD)' (10.0 Mt/yr avoided).
The 25 Mt/yr target is achievable within budget (25.0 Mt/yr).
The plan stays profitable at today's carbon prices but loses most of its upside – stage investments and track carbon-price policy closely.

Only 13% of the budget reaches India, Indonesia, Brazil and South Africa, although they hold top-priority markets (India – Power Industry, India – Agriculture, India – Industrial Combustion). 'Both levers' would raise this to 61% – partner with development banks and secure international carbon-credit buyers for these markets.
